t: Automating Jupyter Notebook Secret Scrubbing & Git Hygiene
s: This article details a process for automatically scrubbing secrets from Jupyter notebooks using Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing and ensuring Git repository hygiene by correctly ignoring local working copies of notebooks while keeping templates versioned.
sub: Jupyter Notebook Git hygiene and secret scrubbing
Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) for generalized API key scrubbing
